verses.pali: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgatā bhikkhunī yathābhataṁ nikkhittā evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: “Mendicants, a nun with five qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.
Without examining or scrutinizing, she praises those deserving of criticism,
and criticizes those deserving of praise.

verses.pali: ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā appasādanīye ṭhāne pasādaṁ upadaṁseti,
verses.english: She arouses faith in things that are dubious,

verses.pali: ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā pasādanīye ṭhāne appasādaṁ upadaṁseti,
verses.english: and doesn’t arouse faith in things that are inspiring.
And she wastes gifts given in faith.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgatā bhikkhunī yathābhataṁ nikkhittā evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: A nun with these five qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgatā bhikkhunī yathābhataṁ nikkhittā evaṁ sagge.
verses.english: A nun with five qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.
After examining and scrutinizing, she criticizes those deserving of criticism,
and praises those deserving of praise.

verses.pali: anuvicca pariyogāhetvā appasādanīye ṭhāne appasādaṁ upadaṁseti,
verses.english: She doesn’t arouse faith in things that are dubious,

verses.pali: anuvicca pariyogāhetvā pasādanīye ṭhāne pasādaṁ upadaṁseti,
verses.english: and does arouse faith in things that are inspiring.
And she doesn’t waste gifts given in faith.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgatā bhikkhunī yathābhataṁ nikkhittā evaṁ sagge”ti.
verses.english: A nun with these five qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.”
